## [CN]规则
## [EN]Rule

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本节按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | **Every package published to an outside registry carries its license (added 2026-11-17).** All code published to an external package registry, including but not limited to CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, Gradle / Maven, npm, pub.dev, ohpm and the WeChat Mini Program components, must contain a license declaration (the `LICENSE` file). Put it inside the package's own built-in resource folder when it has one; when it has none, create one, so the license is packed into every app that installs the package. iOS: the resource bundle (`.bundle`) holds the `LICENSE` file. The same applies to every platform. `python3 scripts/sync-package-licenses.py` writes the files and `--check` fails when one is missing or stale; a new package or a new resource folder adds a row to that script and to the table below. |

## [CN]各平台的位置
## [EN]Where each platform keeps it

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | iOS, CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager (`CYLTabBarController.podspec`, `Package.swift`): `CYLTabBarController/Resources/CYLTabBarController.bundle/LICENSE`, a copy of the repository's `LICENSE`, shipped by `utils.resources` and `.copy(...)`. |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | iOS, `CYLAnimatedItem.podspec`: `CYLTabBarController/CYLAnimatedItem/Resources/CYLAnimatedItem.bundle/LICENSE` (with `POLICY.md`), the component's own license, shipped by `core.resources`. |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | Android, Maven / Gradle (`:cyltabbar`, `:cylanimateditem`, `:tabpages`): `src/main/resources/META-INF/<module>/LICENSE`. Java resources are packed into the AAR / JAR; one folder per module, so an app with several modules gets no duplicate path. The POM also declares the MIT license (`Example-Android/build.gradle.kts`). |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | npm, React Native (`CrossPlatform/react-native-cyltabbar`): the package root's `LICENSE`, which npm always packs. |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | pub.dev, Flutter (`CrossPlatform/flutter_cyltabbar`): the package root's `LICENSE`, which pub requires. |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | ohpm, HarmonyOS (`CrossPlatform/harmonyos-cyltabbar/cyltabbar`): the HAR's root `LICENSE` and `src/main/resources/rawfile/cyltabbar/LICENSE` (raw resources are packed into the app). |
| 本表按用户要求使用英文（见右列）。 | WeChat Mini Program components (`wechat-miniprogram-cyltabbar`, `gif-`, `lottie-`, `pag-`, `rive-`, `svga-miniprogram`): the package root's `LICENSE` and a copy in the folder that DevTools' "build npm" copies into the app (`miniprogram` in `package.json`: `src/` or `miniprogram_dist/`). Third-party libraries vendored there keep their own license next to them (e.g. `miniprogram_dist/libpag/LICENSE.txt`), with a `NOTICE`. `lottie-miniprogram`'s webpack build copies its `LICENSE` into `miniprogram_dist/`. |
